name: The Platinum Discs
summary: A stone watcher holds ancient lore, and you are asked to learn what it knows. Then you can activate the Discs of Norgannon.

sections.title: Lore and Discs
sections.body: You are asked to speak with the stone watcher and learn the ancient lore it keeps. Once you have learned what it offers, you can activate the Discs of Norgannon.

faq.q: What am I asked to do?
faq.answer: You are asked to learn the ancient lore kept by the stone watcher, then activate the Discs of Norgannon.

faq.q: What does the stone watcher know?
faq.answer: The stone watcher keeps ancient lore, which you are asked to learn.

faq.q: What are the Discs of Norgannon?
faq.answer: They are the Discs of Norgannon, which you are asked to activate after learning the stone watcher's lore.

attribution: In-game quest text: The Platinum Discs
